title: Technical solution engineer - sao paulo
description:
Nova oportunidade para Technical solution engineer - sao paulo em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About CATL CATL invites you to continue our legend of green energy! CATL is a World Fortune 300 Company, a global leader who provides premier EV battery and energy storage battery for the world. CATL's EV battery consumption volume has ranked No.1 in the world for seven consecutive years and global energy storage battery shipment has also ranked No.1 for three consecutive years. Job Description ESS Technical Solution Engineer is the combination of application engineer and sales engineer. A technical solution engineer should support and service the customer by demonstrating the product function, technical benefits and value to help customer meet their company and business goals and help company to win projects. Combining technical knowledge with strong communication and interpersonal skills, work closely with clients, understanding their specific needs, and then leverage their in-depth understanding of the company's products or services to provide tailored solutions that meet those needs effectively. Additionally, technical solution engineers should gather feedback from clients and bridge the gap between internal development team and customer requirements, helping to refine products and services based on customer needs and experiences. Responsibilities: Product Demonstration: Deep understanding of the products or services of products and company. Be able to explain complex technical concepts to clients in a clear and understandable manner and contribute to sales presentations, as well as demonstrating products benefits, value and completed applications Client Engagement: Interact directly with clients to understand their needs, challenges, and requirements as well as the competition information from the competitors. Engage in discussions to gather information, analyze the client's projects and requirements, and identify opportunities where company's solutions can add value to win the opportunities Solution Development: Once understand the client's needs, sales engineers work to develop solutions that align with the client's projects. This may involve collaborating with the technical team to design tailored solutions that address specific challenges. Provide clients with technical support as needed and relay information to our development teams for product development and update needs Proposal Creation: Create detailed proposals that outline the proposed solution and its benefits. These proposals need to address the technical aspects while also highlighting the business value for the client as well as prepare the documents according to customer requirements which may include specifications, user's manual, disposal proposal, etc., Technical Support: Provide ongoing technical support to clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping with any technical issues that arise Technical Agreement Negotiations: Involve in negotiations with clients, addressing any technical concerns, clarifying expectations, and ensuring that both parties are aligned on the proposed solution to form final technical agreement Risk Assessment and Problem Solving: Identify the possible issues ahead and provide preventative solutions for the risks. Resolve the technical issues during manufacturing, delivering and commissioning until successfully hand over to customer. Cooperate with internal development and project management team if needed Market Research: Stay informed about market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback. Generate ideas for product and service improvement and innovation based on market trends and customer inputs  Requirements and skills: Based in (or open to relocation) Sao Paulo At least 2 years work experience in local ESS market Previous work experience as an AE or SE of ESS market is advantageous Previous experience in utility or ESS developer company is advantageous Knowledge of local ESS projects development requirements is advantageous Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills Excellent market and competitor analysis abilities Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities Superb collaboration and communication Superb logical and strategic thinking abilities Proficient in English & Portuguese

title: Programa trainee vértua: formação de assessores
description:
Confira a vaga para Programa trainee vértua: formação de assessores em cascavel. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A Vértua Investimentos está selecionando novos talentos para integrar sua operação em Cascavel. Nosso Programa Trainee foi desenvolvido para quem deseja construir uma carreira sólida e de alta performance no mercado financeiro, com um caminho claro e meritocrático para se tornar sócio do escritório. Não exigimos experiência prévia ou certificações iniciais. Nosso foco é investir no seu potencial e fornecer as ferramentas necessárias para sua ascensão profissional. A Trilha de Desenvolvimento do Trainee: Ingresso e Formação Técnica (ANCORD): Você entra no time com contratação imediata. A Vértua fornece o curso preparatório e todo o suporte necessário para que você obtenha a certificação ANCORD o mais rápido possível, habilitando sua atuação oficial no mercado. Imersão Comercial (SDR): Com a certificação em mãos, você inicia sua atuação como SDR (Sales Development Representative). Esta fase é focada no desenvolvimento de habilidades de prospecção e relacionamento, aprendendo a dominar a abordagem estratégica e a psicologia do investidor. Aceleração por Meritocracia: O programa é pautado por resultados. Ao atingir as metas estabelecidas na fase de SDR, você dobra seu salário base, marcando sua prontidão para os próximos níveis de responsabilidade. Ascensão a Assessor de Investimentos: Após o sucesso comercial inicial, você assume sua própria carteira de clientes, atuando na gestão patrimonial e no atendimento direto a investidores. Liderança e Partnership (Sociedade): Profissionais que demonstram excelência na entrega e capacidade de gestão ascendem à liderança de times. Na Vértua, o resultado entregue desde o primeiro dia como assessor é o critério para o ingresso no plano de sociedade, permitindo que você se torne sócio do negócio. Requisitos do Programa: Paixão pelo Mercado Financeiro: Este é o nosso único requisito essencial. Você não precisa saber o que é um "CDB" hoje, mas deve ter um interesse real em aprender e dominar o assunto. Gosto em Aprender: O dia a dia da profissão exige conversar com pessoas constantemente. É fundamental estar aberto e disposto para construir relacionamentos profissionais, entender as dificuldades e absorver experiências. Perfil Ambicioso: Buscamos pessoas que não se acomodam com o fixo e desejam o crescimento acelerado que apenas o ganho variável e a sociedade podem proporcionar. Localidade: Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Cascavel/PR. O que a Vértua oferece: Contratação imediata com plano de carreira estruturado; Curso preparatório para ANCORD totalmente custeado pela empresa; Cultura de Meritocracia Radical (dobra salarial por performance); Oportunidade realde Equity (Sociedade) baseada em resultados. Como se candidatar: Se você deseja transformar seu interesse pelo mercado financeiro em uma carreira de sócio em um dos escritórios que mais cresce na região, candidate-se agora!

description:

This role is pivotal in driving revenue growth, establishing long-term customer relationships, and strengthening our market position internationally. Your Role and Responsibilities Business Development & Revenue Generation: Take full ownership of achieving and exceeding assigned annual sales targets for the designated territory.  Aggressively identify, generate, and pursue new sales leads and business opportunities within the energy sector.  Customer & Channel Management: Develop and maintain long-term, strategic relationships with a diverse client base, including utility companies, EPC contractors, distributors, and end-users.  Manage key accounts to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction, account growth, and contract renewal.  Strategic Sales Execution: Conduct in-depth customer needs analysis and develop tailored solutions and compelling proposals to win business. Provide insightful market analysis reports to inform product development and strategic planning. Oversee post-sales support coordination to resolve issues promptly and maintain customer satisfaction. Strong sales track record of meeting or exceeding quotas and managing complex B2 B sales cycles. Experience with Latin American markets is highly desirable.  Required Skills Sales Expertise: Demonstrated ability in key account management, channel development, and complex project negotiation.  Communication: Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and proposal-writing skills. Fluency in Portuguese is mandatory.  Personal Attributes: Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and customer-focused. Possess strong business acumen, market sensitivity, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-cultural environment. description:

A Hellotext é a plataforma de marketing conversacional e automação que impulsiona vendas para algumas das marcas de e-commerce mais ambiciosas da América Latina. Com uma base de clientes em rápido crescimento, estamos expandindo nossa presença país por país — e o Brasil é a próxima grande prioridade. Esta não é uma posição de suporte ou pré-vendas. Você será a liderança comercial da Hellotext no Brasil, com foco absoluto em vendas enterprise, abertura de mercado e geração de receita. Sua missão Construir e escalar a operação comercial da Hellotext no Brasil, fechando as primeiras contas estratégicas, abrindo relacionamento com líderes C-Level e estabelecendo a empresa como referência em marketing conversacional para e-commerce e varejo enterprise. Você será responsável por gerar, qualificar e fechar negócios, além de criar as bases para o crescimento futuro do país. O que você fará Liderar o go-to-market comercial da Hellotext no Brasil, com foco em vendas B2 B enterprise. Prospectar, desenvolver e fechar negócios com marcas médias e enterprise de e-commerce e varejo. Abrir e manter relacionamento direto com CMOs, Heads de E-commerce, Diretores Digitais e VPs. Executar outbound estratégico multicanal (Linked In, telefone, Whats App, eventos, visitas presenciais). Conduzir reuniões executivas, apresentações comerciais e negociações complexas. Adaptar o discurso comercial, posicionamento e narrativa da Hellotext para o mercado brasileiro (PT-BR). Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Produto e Marketing para levar feedback real de mercado e influenciar roadmap. Echosens is shaping the future of liver health. As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care. In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes. Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health. To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a: CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W) LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil) The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education. This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients. Main activities: Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens Fibro Scan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise  Experience / Education / Special Requirements You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems. You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent. Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. title: Public policy director latam
description:
Empresa está contratando Public policy director latam em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role summary We are seeking an experienced Public Affairs Specialist to strengthen GS1 Global Public Policy team based in Brazil. Working with the Public Policy team and reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Public Policy, the successful candidate will have 10+ years of prior experience in public policy and government engagement across Latin America (LATAM). This role is a unique opportunity to set the foundation of international public policy across the LATAM region (including Central and South America) with a global perspective. The successful candidate will act as a public policy strategist developing and implementing plans with GS1 Member Organisations in the LATAM Region and with Global Office. They will be GS1's day-to-day point of contact for engagement with GS1 Member Organisations and stakeholders, including governments and regulators, on all public policy matters relevant to GS1 in the region. They will build constructive relationships, provide evidence-based specialist insights, and ensure GS1's positions are understood and reflected in evolving policy frameworks for traceability, trade efficiency, and regulatory compliance across fragmented supply chains.  Education and experience Master's degree with 10+ years of related experience. Stakeholder Networks: Established contacts across national and regional institutions in the LATAM region and experience in building coalitions and coordinating with multi-country stakeholders. A thorough understanding of how international organisations, trade associations, and NGOs function, and work experience in international environments relevant to the region.  Desired experience Sector Knowledge: Understanding of FMCG/retail and consumer goods policy environment (sustainability, product data, packaging, product safety, traceability, e-commerce). Standards & Data: Familiarity with data standards and policy interoperability (preferably GS1 standards, 2 D barcodes, master data, digital product information), and the role of registries in regulatory compliance.  Skills required Strategic Policy Framing: Ability to connect technical standards to policy objectives (consumer protection, sustainability, market surveillance, competition, innovation). Executive Relationships: Credibility with senior officials and industry leaders; ability to develop long-term trusted relationships, adept at informal/formal engagement, drafting amendments and compromise texts. Communication: Excellent written and oral communication in English, Portuguese and Spanish. Analytical Rigour: Strong legislative analysis, impact assessment, and risk/opportunity mapping; able to translate complex dossiers into clear executive guidance. Execution & Collaboration: Comfortable operating in a federated international network; disciplined follow‐through across multiple files; high integrity and respect for competition‐law constraints. Public Representation: Confident public speaker; able to present GS1's neutral, standards‐based positions in diverse regional fora.  Additional Information This job requires up to 25% global travel. How to apply Email your cover letter with CV (ENGLISH ONLY) to:  ; include the job title in the subject line. Responses will be treated quickly and with strict confidentiality.

title: Product designer
description:
Empresa está contratando Product designer em florianópolis. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Buscamos umProduct Designerpara criar experiências digitais simples, intuitivas e agradáveis que ajudem milhares de academias e profissionais do fitness a gerenciar seus negócios com eficiência, reduzindo fricções, acelerando resultados e ampliando o impacto positivo da Next Fit na vida das pessoas.Qual será a sua missão?Criar telas, fluxos e componentes visuais para web e mobile baseados no design system da Next Fit.Garantir consistência, escalabilidade e guidelines claras entre produtos.Transformar requisitos técnicos e de negócio em interfaces intuitivas e agradáveis.Realizar pesquisas com usuários (surveys, entrevistas, testes de usabilidade).Mapear jornadas, criar fluxos, wireframes e protótipos navegáveis.Identificar pontos de fricção e propor melhorias que aumentem retenção, engajamento e “time to value”.Manter, documentar e expandir o design system da Next Fit (componentes, tokens, padrões).Garantir governança e coerência visual nas entregas do time de produto e marketing.Acompanhar KPIs de design (usabilidade, taxa de sucesso, engajamento).Propor testes A/B, medir impacto e iterar rapidamente.Praticar aprendizado contínuo, mantendo-se atualizado em tendências de UI/UX Saa S.Trabalhar próximo ao time de Produto, Engenharia, Marketing e CS na definição de funcionalidades.Participar de rituais ágeis (planning, refinamento, review).Competências mínimas:Experiência comprovada em UI/UX/ Product Designer (mínimo 1 ano atuando em produto digital).Domínio de Figma (componentes, autolayout, prototipação, libraries).Vivência com pesquisa de usuários, testes de usabilidade e heurísticas.Capacidade forte de criar interfaces limpas, funcionais e responsivas.O que oferecemos:Vale Alimentação (R$750,00) - Para suas refeições serem tão incríveis quanto o seu talento!Plano de Saúde - Sua saúde em boas mãos, sempre.Estacionamento próprio - Sem estresse, seu carro tem vaga garantida.Gympass/Wellhub - Escolha sua atividade e cuide de você!Frutas liberadas - Os lanches saudáveis são por nossa conta.Day off de aniversário - Um dia inteirinho para celebrar sua vida do seu jeito.Sala de descanso e jogos - Para relaxar, dar boas risadas e renovar as energias.Plataforma de Educação - Seu crescimento profissional merece espaço para voar alto.Biblioteca recheada de títulos - Expanda sua mente e inspire suas ideias.Plano de carreira - Um futuro construído junto, com oportunidades reais de crescimento.Não perca esta oportunidade! Dê o próximo passo para alcançar o sucesso em sua carreira e vem para a legião de roxinhos!

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
Confira a vaga para Strategic partnership & alliance em sapiranga. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAMIdentify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystemCollaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreementsRepresent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutionsMonitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenueProvide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work ExperienceBachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystemKnowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structuresAwareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilitiesExcellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levelsAdvanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and EnglishAbility to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targetsEntrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovationCulturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote teamHigh level of integrity, professionalism, and ownershipResilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: Implementation analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Implementation analyst em eldorado do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:BrazilType:Full-Time ContractSetup:Fully RemoteLevel:Mid-LevelIndustry:Software SAAS CompanyShift:US HoursStart Date:can start in 2 weeks after offerEquipment:Available upon requestRate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical GroupThe Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the OpportunityOur client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.ResponsibilitiesLead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.QualificationsAt least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

Nova oportunidade para Implementation analyst em jundiaí. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:BrazilType:Full-Time ContractSetup:Fully RemoteLevel:Mid-LevelIndustry:Software SAAS CompanyShift:US HoursStart Date:can start in 2 weeks after offerEquipment:Available upon requestRate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical GroupThe Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the OpportunityOur client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.ResponsibilitiesLead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.QualificationsAt least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
Empresa está contratando Strategic partnership & alliance em sorocaba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.ResponsibilitiesLead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent configurations.Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.QualificationsAt least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:BrazilType:Full-Time ContractSetup:Fully RemoteLevel:Mid-LevelIndustry:Software SAAS CompanyShift:US HoursStart Date:can start in 2 weeks after offerEquipment:Available upon requestRate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical GroupThe Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the OpportunityOur client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.ResponsibilitiesLead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.QualificationsAt least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. description:

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and
